title: Train After You Measure: a Pre-Registered Learning Curve for Fine-Tuning Typed Decision Models on One User's Labels
abstract: arXiv:2611.21393v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Fine-tuning a small typed decision model on one user's email labels did not clear the margin we pre-registered over a logistic regression trained on the same labels. In earlier work, about two hundred labels and a TF-IDF logistic regression had the highest point accuracy on this inbox, though not significantly above the best hosted model; we ask whether the same labels, given to a decision model, close the gap. A first registered study, on a generic 4B base with cross-validation and message type only, stayed below the baseline at every label budget (-1.8 to -7.3 points). The main study was registered before any fine-tuning run: a fixed test set of 135 emails never used for selection, LoRA adapters on the public Tev1-0.8B and Tev1-4B decision models, nested subsets of 50 to 587 labels, two seeds and five decision fields on a free T4 GPU. translated_title: 先测量后训练：在单一用户标签上微调类型化决策模型的预注册学习曲线
translated_abstract: 在单一用户的电子邮件标签上微调一个小型类型化决策模型，未能达到我们预先注册的、相对于在同一标签上训练的逻辑回归的优势差距。在早期工作中，约两百个标签和TF-IDF逻辑回归在此收件箱上取得了最高的点精度，尽管并未显著高于最佳的托管模型；我们提出的问题是：同样的标签交给决策模型是否能缩小这一差距。第一项注册研究在通用4B基座模型上进行，采用交叉验证且仅针对消息类型，在每个标签预算下均低于基线（-1.8至-7.3个百分点）。主研究在任何微调运行之前即已注册：使用一个从未用于模型选择的固定测试集（135封电子邮件），在公开的Tev1-0.8B和Tev1-4B决策模型上使用LoRA适配器，涵盖50至587个标签的嵌套子集，两个随机种子和五个决策字段，全部在免费的T4 GPU上运行。其五个假设中有四个被证伪——其中两个反而有利于微调——另有一个在某一模（型）上得到证实……
tldr: 该论文通过一项预先注册的学习曲线实验证明，在单一用户的邮件标签上用LoRA微调小型类型化决策模型（Tev1-0.8B/4B），在所有标签预算下均未能超越简单的TF-IDF逻辑回归基线，且五个假设中四个被证伪。
en_tdlr: A pre-registered learning-curve study shows that LoRA fine-tuning of small typed decision models (Tev1-0.8B/4B) on one user's email labels fails to beat a TF-IDF logistic regression baseline at every label budget, with four of five hypotheses refuted.
